about.title: About
about.body: This page demonstrates localized pathnames (look at the URL: /about, /ru/o-nas, /uk/pro-nas) and server-side translations via getTranslations.

plurals.title: Plurals & interpolation
plurals.intro: Try changing the count and name below. Switch the locale in the header to see how plural forms differ.
plurals.items: {count, plural, =0 {no items} one {# item} other {# items}}
plurals.terms: I agree to the terms and privacy policy
plurals.step: {step, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} step

formats.title: Formats
formats.intro: Named formats (short, long, withTime, currency, percent) come from src/shared/i18n/request.ts; the rest use inline options.

errorsDemo.title: Error boundary
errorsDemo.intro: The button throws during rendering. The localized [locale]/error.tsx catches it, and “Try again” re-renders the segment.
